title: ERF.PRECISE and ERFC.PRECISE: every figure is truth, identity or model - none production
status_plain: No production OxFunc pass rate exists for either surface. What exists is three other kinds of number. First, Excel against mathematical truth: Excel's own erf is near-correctly-rounded at 158 of 176, which is what rules out NSWC (113), Cody CALERF (121 for erf and 56 for erfc), and pins fdlibm, Boost and UCRT as non-matches too. Second, Excel against Excel: the cross-view wiring proof, 160 of 160 twice, which is what identified ERF/ERFC.PRECISE as the NSWC gratio a<1 branches themselves rather than any coefficient table. Third, research models: the best true-x87 race scores 663 of 1218. A 256-row held-out promotion gate exists and has never been raced.

open_question: The b9heldout corpus, 256 rows, has NEVER been raced and is the reserved promotion gate. No candidate has earned the right to be scored on it.
reader_warning: None of these figures is a production pass rate for either surface. Two of them measure Excel against truth, one measures Excel against Excel, and the rest score research models. Reading 158/176 or 160/160 as OxFunc's agreement with Excel would invert what they mean.

schema_additions: counts[].source_sentence — the verbatim source sentence carrying the figure (mandated: every figure must be traceable to a quoted sentence).
counts[].figure_display_only — const true; makes FOUNDATION §2.5's 'figure is display only, guard G-9' explicit on the datum itself.

counts[].builds / build_ambiguity / arch / cpu / cpu_scoped / excel_bitness / workbook_mode / plumbing — FOUNDATION puts these in a record-level `oracle` object. They are carried PER COUNT here so that no count can inherit an environment from a sibling count in the same record.

counts[].currency — enum current | current-and-only | superseded | pre-repair-baseline | stale-in-source | withdrawn. Answers ATTRIBUTION-CORRECTIONS §2.3 item 2: a superseded figure must be dispositioned 'superseded', not silently absent.
counts[].ambiguity_note — nullable; the published statement of an unresolved source ambiguity attached to this specific figure.

counts[].measurement_subject gains the value 'handbook-recomputation-over-cached-corpus' — a computation over stored bits performed by an agent, NOT a live-Excel oracle run. Required by the re-measurement rule; such counts always carry handbook_reverified:false and may never be shelved beside an oracle run.
